message: Proposed a furnished three-storey concept within your 30 × 24 m footprint: ground-floor bank, first-floor cafe and second-floor IT office for 24 people. Two stairs, a lift, toilets and service rooms align vertically. Assumed 4 m storeys; structure, orientation, accessibility details and MEP remain to be resolved.

proposal.name: Bank, Cafe & IT Building
notes: Editable concept for review; dimensions are proposed geometry in metres, not surveyed measurements.
Floor order: bank at ground, cafe at level 1, IT office at level 2. Storey heights are assumed at 4 m.
Internal walls are generally 0.18 m. Stair, lift and vault enclosures use 0.28 m; allow a 0.28 m external envelope in subsequent architectural detailing.
Two aligned stairs, lift, toilets and services occupy the rear core. A 2 m cross corridor joins a 2 m arrival spine on each floor.
Bank teller stations straddle the public/secure boundary intentionally. Controlled staff doors separate cash handling, vault and operations from customers.
Cafe includes 20 main dining seats plus two furnished lounge groups, an espresso counter, kitchen, wash-up and food storage.
Office includes 24 furnished workstations, two four-seat meeting rooms, two focus rooms and a separate controlled server room.
Ground entrance is assumed on the top edge; stair discharge doors are proposed on opposite side edges. Site access, setbacks, parking, orientation and external landing space are unknown.
Meeting room 2, consultation 2 and quiet room 2 are accessed through their adjacent companion room; an independent internal access corridor should be considered during detailed development.

Structural grid, fire strategy, toilet capacity, lift specification, HVAC, kitchen extraction and costs require further design. This concept does not establish code compliance or construction readiness.
